name: Farya
source:
Farya is unapologetically enthusiastic - especially when it comes to taking care of the sick and injured, like any good doctor. If you need a bandaid and a kiss on a bruised knee, she's your gal. If you need to know the symptoms of diphtheria, mononucleosis and mumps, she's also your gal. If she goes on and on about all the possible illnesses and ailments you might have, she's only doing it because she cares. Injuries are rare enough that when someone does need her, she desperately wants to get it right.
Likes: Diagnosing, Strange Humours, Blood, Guts 
Dislikes: Studying

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
